title: Warehouse Content (inventory, v1)
description: What's actually stocked in a warehouse, separate from its physical layout (see warehouse.schema.json, whose `id` this file references as `warehouseId`). Loaded second, after the configuration file, and merged with it in memory. A slot absent from `slots`, or a sub-slot with no pallets, is simply empty — this file only needs to describe what's actually there.

warehouseId.description: The warehouse.schema.json config's `id` this content belongs to.

slotId.description: References a slot `id` in the matching warehouse.schema.json config.

subSlots.description: One entry per depth position (see the config slot's `depth`), front-to-back. Shorter than the config's depth is fine — missing positions are treated as empty.

pallets.description: Stacked bottom-to-top; pallets[0] is the lowest tier.
